about: Procedural course pieces for Stage D (SPEC §7.11). Ranges are [low, high], drawn evenly. Lengths in m, angles in degrees, impulses in N·s and N·m·s. run_out_m is flat floor kept after a piece (the landing zone) before the next checkpoint. Kept to what the driver bot with PD finishes (98 of 100 seeds): curved ramps up to 18° and 8-10 m wide, kickers 3.5-4.5 m wide so an off-centre car still gets both wheels on, gentle bumps, gaps the car clears at 10 m/s. Walls are off (weight 0): their 30° ramp throws a car going over 20 m/s about 10 m up, and PD crashes most of those landings.
